title: Tokenisation via Convex Relaxations

read_scope.text: Full v1 HTML main text sections 1-6, footnotes, references and appendices A-J including tabular numerical values.
read_scope.visual: All 26 PDF pages inspected in five six-page contact sheets at 65 dpi, including Figures 1-34 and Tables 1-15. Values used in this project are original executable tiny computations, not digitized plot values.
read_scope.not_reviewed: No linked upstream tokenizer repository, model weights or training corpus was cloned, installed, executed or independently audited. Cited third-party papers are not claimed as read.

implementation.search: Pinned original toy corpora discovered using Python random.Random(22821); final checks use literal corpora and no randomness.
implementation.solver: scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs'), existing scipy 1.13.1 CPU environment; every displayed LP optimum has a separately checked exact rational primal-dual witness.

cache_policy: Raw retrieved HTML/PDF and normalized review text/contact sheets are preserved locally and excluded by planning/convextok/.gitignore. This manifest pins bytes without checking a full third-party article into the project.
